infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Charioteer uses the microphone if you start a voice conversation with Thumos. Full voice is not finished in this version.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Charioteer uses the camera so you can take a private progress photo. Other people cannot see it, and it is not sent to the coach.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Charioteer uses your photo library so you can add a private progress photo. Other people cannot see it, and it is not sent to the coach.

plugins.photosPermission: Charioteer uses your photo library so you can add a private progress photo. Other people cannot see it, and it is not sent to the coach.
plugins.cameraPermission: Charioteer uses the camera so you can take a private progress photo. Other people cannot see it, and it is not sent to the coach.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Charioteer reads steps, sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, workouts, and weight so you and Thumos can see how your body is doing. Other people cannot see this.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Charioteer does not write to Apple Health. This message is required because the app includes the HealthKit capability.
